SECTION 1
* A young person agrees with Sajid Javid’s point that millennials struggle to afford homes, despite older people blaming them for spending on things like holidays or dining out.
* Rising house prices, limited housing, and strict bank lending make homeownership seem impossible for many young people.
* The writer feels young people are stuck renting forever, enriching landlords while being judged as irresponsible.
* Under-25s earn less than older workers, with some as young as 21-24 paid as little as £7.05/hour and 18-20-year-olds as low as £5.60/hour for the same work.
* Many young workers also face unstable jobs like zero-hours contracts, making financial security even harder.
